$comment: Catalogue of Google MCP servers. NOT active configuration — /google:mcp reads this and writes chosen entries into the PROJECT's .mcp.json. No credentials here, ever: env values are variable names the user supplies. toolCount/schemaBytes were measured, not estimated; see measuredAt.

notes.remoteAuth: Every *.googleapis.com/mcp endpoint answers initialize and tools/list WITHOUT credentials, so it connects, dumps its whole tool schema into the session, and only fails when a tool is actually called. accounts.google.com exposes no registration_endpoint, so Dynamic Client Registration is impossible and Claude Code cannot self-register: pass your own OAuth client with `claude mcp add --client-id <id> --client-secret --callback-port <port>`. Run /google:setup for the walkthrough.
notes.cost: Measured 2026-08-05: the 13 reachable remote servers total 151 tools and 1580 KB of JSON schema — roughly 400k tokens if enabled together. Enable per project, not globally.

resource-manager.title: Cloud Resource Manager
resource-manager.notes: Cheapest remote server — use it to validate the OAuth client flow before enabling any other.

gke.title: Google Kubernetes Engine
gke.notes: Prefer this over GoogleCloudPlatform/gke-mcp locally — that one needs a Go toolchain.

cloudsql.title: Cloud SQL Admin
cloudsql.notes: The most expensive server measured: 465 KB of schema on its own.

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.notes: The gws-gmail-* skills cover the same ground through the CLI at near-zero context cost.

drive.title: Google Drive
drive.notes: Overlaps the gws-drive-* skills; prefer those unless you need the MCP surface.

workspace-developer.title: Workspace Developer docs
workspace-developer.notes: Replaces the archived googleworkspace/developer-mcp npm package. Often already present in ~/.claude.json — /google:mcp refuses to duplicate it.

toolbox.title: MCP Toolbox for Databases
toolbox.notes: Renamed from googleapis/genai-toolbox. Covers AlloyDB, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Spanner, Firestore plus Postgres, MySQL, Mongo, Redis and more. Pick the backend with TOOLBOX_PREBUILT.

google-ads.title: Google Ads
google-ads.warning: Install from git only. The PyPI package google-ads-mcp is a dead 0.0.1 stub. The older google-marketing-solutions/google_ads_mcp_server repo is archived and redirects here.
google-ads.notes: Needs a developer token with at least Explorer access. GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID only when entering through an MCC.

analytics.title: Google Analytics (GA4)
analytics.notes: Read-only. Covers both the Admin API (metadata) and the Data API (reporting). Enable both APIs in the GCP project.

gsc.title: Google Search Console
gsc.notes: Google publishes no official GSC MCP server. Chosen over ahonn/mcp-server-gsc and AkashRajpurohit/gsc-mcp because it is the only one with browser OAuth — a service account would have to be added by hand as a user on every property. Writes stay off unless GSC_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=true.

firebase.title: Firebase
firebase.notes: The MCP server ships inside firebase-tools; there is no standalone repo.

cloud-run-local.title: Cloud Run (deploy)
cloud-run-local.notes: Deploys apps to Cloud Run. The remote cloud-run server is read/manage oriented; this one builds and ships.

unavailable.storage: https://storage.googleapis.com/mcp returns 400 InvalidArgument — Cloud Storage has no MCP endpoint under that hostname.
unavailable.chronicle: https://chronicle.googleapis.com/mcp serves an HTML error page, not MCP. Google Security Operations is at github.com/google/mcp-security instead.
unavailable.gws: The Google Workspace CLI removed its `gws mcp` subcommand in 0.8.0 — a Discovery-API-wide MCP server exposed 200-400 tools. The gws-* skills in this plugin replace it at a fraction of the context cost.
